text:
Priya: Quick sync on an on-prem/bare-metal beta cohort. Aim: 6 partners (fintech + health + infra). 8-week pilot. Primary success = production-grade perf (p90 latency within target, token cost delta <=15%). Secondary = integration effort <=40 eng hours/customer. Screening + incentive ideas?

Sam: Two-tier cohort: 3 deep integrators (kernel/workload tuning) + 3 API-only partners. Screening needs: infra type, expected peak QPS, compliance, team SLA owner.

Evan: We need a kernel compatibility checklist, minimum GPU spec (e.g., 2xA10 equivalent), and an install window for first deploy. Flag any partner under-min spec.

Maya: Feedback cadence proposal: weekly meetings first 3 weeks, then biweekly. Eval suite: latency (p50/p90), correctness/regression tests, tokens-per-inference, integration friction survey. Example eval snippet:
```
Eval: 50 customer prompts
metrics: p50/p90 latency, accuracy@threshold, tokens/inference
```

Jordan: Legal: customers must sign a Data Collection Addendum permitting anonymized telemetry. Also require rollback SLA (48h) if regressions impact traffic. I'll loop in Legal and draft consent.

Priya: Incentives: 3 months discounted Dedicated capacity OR $10k engineering credit + 40h SE support + priority roadmap influence + co-marketing on success. Good?

Sam: I'll draft the intake form + outreach message. DraftQs: primary use-case, infra type (k8s/baremetal), peak QPS, compliance, telemetry consent, contact + SLA owner.

Evan: Add explicit data residency question and nightly anonymized telemetry acceptance. We need telemetry to validate caching/batching wins.

Maya: Acceptance gates (pass/fail):
- Perf: p90 <= 1.3x hosted baseline for 90% of eval runs
- Stability: error rate not >0.5% above baseline
- Integration: E2E demo in staging within 4 weeks
If any gate fails -> mitigation plan + escalation.

Jordan: I'll prepare a marketing opt-out clause in the consent.

Priya: Owners & deadlines: Sam -> form + outreach (Mon EOD), Evan -> infra checklist + deploy window (Wed), Maya -> eval harness + prompts (Wed), Jordan -> legal template (Thu). I'll consolidate invite list and send.

dp-bot: "On-Prem Beta Intake" form created: form ID 0Bz7. Link posted in #product.

Priya: Thanks. Next sync Thurs 10am to review first responses. Drop updates here if you can't make. :rocket:
